messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling out model-router v4.0.0 -> canary (apac-south1). Triggering post-deploy smoke: crypto-probe + quick-evict. Report anomalies.

tess: crypto-probe checksum mismatches in apac after wave 1, 7/20 failing with verifier mismatch. No 5xx.

miguel: paste of one failing probe payload header: `X-Model-Version: v4.0.0`, `X-Checksum-Expected: 0x9f3a`, `X-Checksum-Actual: 0x1b2c`. Looks like binary build mismatch?

sre-oncall: only apac affected; eu/apac-other/na are green. Recommend regional pin to last-known-good v3.9.8 and hold further apac waves.

release-manager: agree. Pinting region is lowest blast radius. I'll record brief note to release changelog.

miguel: applied routing.pin -> region=apac-south1, target_version=3.9.8, actor=miguel (3319990018). deploy-bot: logged action.

tess: re-run smoke: crypto-probe apac-south1 -> 20/20 OK, checksums match.

sre-oncall: opening ENG-9733 to investigate build artifact signing and checksum drift between our build farm and the apac cache. Assign to @miguel and @tess.

release-manager: added release note: "apac-south1 pinned to v3.9.8 due to checksum mismatch on crypto-probe in v4.0.0; rollout continues elsewhere; ENG-9733 filed."

miguel: will also add a preflight to verify artifact checksum before region traffic flip. Leaving thread open for ENG-9733 updates. :white_check_mark:
